evaluable_rule: n_cells >= 20 and at least 3 BACH1-detected plus 3 BACH1-undetected cells
multiplicity_note: The two-sided per-patient QC coefficient test was treated as a single prespecified conservative sensitivity test for the primary shared-gene-removed DoRothEA score; therefore, no additional multiplicity adjustment was required within this analysis.
note: Per-patient OLS models used the shared-gene-removed DoRothEA BACH1 score as the outcome. Covariates were z-scored within patient; epithelial states were simplified and rare states were pooled.
